pureline_maintenance_body: PureLine filter cartridges must be replaced according to the recommended maintenance schedule. Failure to replace cartridges in a timely manner may cause certain filter media to soften, deteriorate, or disintegrate, potentially resulting in plumbing blockages, equipment malfunction, or damage to the plumbing system.
